summary: RAG perspective ensemble + LoRA adapter v2a_e1
hypothesis: Combining the ragPerspectiveEnsemble in-context topology from exp021 with the champion LoRA adapter v2a_e1 should yield additive gains — the adapter's fine-tuned judgment paired with diverse RAG-seeded perspective drafts should outperform either lever alone.
technique: A matrix sweep crossing the ragPerspectiveEnsemble in-context pipeline topology (from exp021) with the best LoRA adapter (v2a_e1): RAG retrieval feeds a multi-perspective ensemble of on-device adapter calls, evaluated greedy on the full-30 held-out set.
result: Scored 0.223 on the full-30 greedy gate — above the raw exp021 baseline (0.177) but far below the champion exp056 (0.440). The combination failed to produce additive gains; the hypothesis was falsified and the run was discarded.
